request_text: You get 2 messages to me, and anything after that is turned away. You get 43 steps, and every tool call burns one. A sold-out item is a dead card in my hand, so every last item should be available to ship. I feel like someone staring at a full deck and being told to pick just one card, with no peeking. My old recording rig has a board with an LGA 1200 socket, and I am swapping the processor while the case is already open on the kitchen table. The shelf has a whole row of chips that all drop into that same socket, and the differences are a mystery to me. The whole haul gets 66500 cents in US currency, all in, and the house does not get one cent more. The hand I am drawing to: 3 fishing lines with 16 strands, plus 3 CPUs with an LGA 1200 socket. My bandmate left one name on a sticky note, so I would rather you ask than guess.
